test_title: PYST 19: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"reality."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Reality"** refers to something that actually exists or happens, as opposed to something that is imagined or fictional. (वास्‍तविकता, यथार्थ (जीवन जैसा है वैसा, न कि जैसा वह लग सकता है या जैसा हमें पसंद है))

 
 
• **Example:** *I enjoyed my holiday, but now it’s back to **reality**__.*
 
 
 
• Grammatically, it is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• The correct answer is option 3.
 
• Correct passage: 

The __challenge__ of climate change is one of the most pressing issues facing the world today. Rising temperatures, extreme weather events and melting ice caps are just a few of the __consequences__ of a changing climate. To combat this, many countries have pledged to reduce their greenhouse gas emissions, but progress has been slow. In addition, some people are still sceptical of the __**reality**__ of climate change or believe that it's a natural occurrence that humans can't do much about. However, scientists agree that urgent action is needed to prevent the worst impacts of climate change. This includes not only reducing emissions but also adapting to the changes that have already ______ (4) _______. This might involve building sea walls to protect against rising sea levels, planting drought-resistant crops or developing new technologies to remove carbon from the atmosphere. Ultimately, addressing climate change will require a ______ (5) _______ effort from individuals, governments and businesses around the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Fiction** refers to literature or stories that are made up or imagined. (कहानियाँ, उपन्‍यास, कथाएँ आदि जो काल्‍पनिक घटनाओं और व्‍यक्तियों का वर्णन करते हैं; कथा-साहित्‍य)
 
• **Myth** refers to a traditional story or belief that explains the customs or beliefs of a society. (मिथक, पौराणिक कथा (जो विशेषतया देवताओं और वीर पुरुषों के विषय में होती हैं और जिनमें प्रायः प्राकृतिक या ऐतिहासिक घटनाओं का वर्णन होता है))
 
• **Deception** refers to the act of deliberately misleading or tricking someone. (धोखा देने की क्रिया)

4a:T1093,

The correct answer is **"occurred."**
